title: Knowledge
summary: The root of the owner's private, progressively discoverable knowledge base.

about.title: About
about.summary: Knowledge whose subject is the owner, organized around the durable personal context that matters in this instance.

automations.title: Automations
automations.summary: Instructions and supporting assets used by automations running in external harnesses.

automations/activity-distiller.title: Activity distiller
automations/activity-distiller.summary: Canonical instructions and minimal checkpoint state for reconciling connected activity into maintained knowledge.

automations/diary-composer.title: Diary composer
automations/diary-composer.summary: Canonical instructions and minimal checkpoint state for composing diary-worthy activity deltas into linked day narratives.

companies.title: Companies
companies.summary: Identified organizations and their factual, relational, and dated context in the owner's world.

events.title: Events
events.summary: Identified occasions such as conferences, dinners, museum visits, hackathons, and weddings, grouped by date.

library.title: Library
library.summary: Identified external works, their useful content, the owner's grounded reaction, and connected subjects.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.summary: Bounded synchronous conversations among people, their substantive account, and resulting relationships.

objects.title: Objects
objects.summary: Identified physical instances whose particulars or history are maintained over time.

people.title: People
people.summary: Identified people, who they are, their supported relationship to the owner, and relevant history.

places.title: Places
places.summary: Identified homes, venues, offices, neighbourhoods, cities, and other particular locations.

skills.title: Skills
skills.summary: Reusable Agent Skills stored as versioned SKILL.md pages.

threads.title: Threads
threads.summary: Resolved lines of written correspondence, preserving what each exchange established and how it moved.

topics.title: Topics
topics.summary: Enduring subjects in the world, including the owner's supported positions, practices, and connections.

trips.title: Trips
trips.summary: Identified journeys away from home, the arc of each one, and the occasions it contained.

about/diary.title: Diary
about/diary.summary: The owner's prose chronology, connecting each day's activity to its durable subjects and genuine earlier threads.

about/projects.title: Projects
about/projects.summary: Enduring bodies of work the owner builds, operates, or stewards, with concise canonical context and curated milestones.

about/tasks.title: Tasks
about/tasks.summary: Durable frames for finite outcomes, decisions, and experiments the owner is pursuing or considering.
